summary.text: Pricella Tiegen is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Jeff Livingston and Libertarian Doug Jones in a race with no incumbent.
On her campaign website, she describes herself as a first-generation Hispanic American.

paragraphs.text: Pricella Tiegen advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary for House District 15.
Her campaign website says she is running to protect parental rights and children, the Second Amendment, election integrity, government accountability and public safety.
